jmri_server.services

Per-topic JSON services.

Importing this package returns the canonical list of services. Use register_all() to register them on a ServiceRegistry.

class AudioService(jmri_server.services.beans._BeanService): 
23class AudioService(_BeanService):
24    topic = "audio"
25
26    def manager(self) -> AudioManager:
27        return self.ctx.connection.audios
28
29    def project(self, bean: Audio) -> dict[str, Any]:
30        return _common_named_bean(bean) | {
31            "state": bean.state,
32            "kind": bean.kind,
33            "url": bean.url,
34            "gain": bean.gain,
35        }
36
37    async def apply(self, bean: Audio, data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
38        if "kind" in data:
39            kind = data["kind"]
40            if kind not in ("source", "buffer", "listener"):
41                raise JsonServiceError(400, f"invalid audio kind: {kind!r}")
42            bean.kind = kind
43        if "url" in data:
44            bean.url = str(data["url"]) if data["url"] is not None else None
45        if "gain" in data:
46            try:
47                gain = float(data["gain"])
48            except (TypeError, ValueError):
49                raise JsonServiceError(400, "audio.gain must be numeric") from None
50            if not 0.0 <= gain <= 1.0:
51                raise JsonServiceError(400, "audio.gain must be in [0.0, 1.0]")
52            bean.gain = gain
53        # Explicit state override (rare — clients normally send
54        # ``command`` instead) but scripts sometimes set state directly.
55        if "state" in data:
56            state = int(data["state"])
57            if state not in (AUDIO_STATE_STOPPED, AUDIO_STATE_PLAYING):
58                raise JsonServiceError(
59                    400,
60                    f"audio.state must be {AUDIO_STATE_STOPPED} (stopped) or "
61                    f"{AUDIO_STATE_PLAYING} (playing)",
62                )
63            if state == AUDIO_STATE_PLAYING:
64                await bean.play()
65            else:
66                await bean.stop()
67        # JMRI Java's Play / Stop verbs. Only meaningful on sources; a
68        # buffer or listener silently no-ops the command rather than
69        # 400-ing to keep the API forgiving for polymorphic clients.
70        command = data.get("command")
71        if command == "Play":
72            if bean.kind == "source":
73                await bean.play()
74        elif command == "Stop":
75            if bean.kind == "source":
76                await bean.stop()
77        elif command is not None:
78            raise JsonServiceError(400, f"unknown audio command: {command!r}")

class BeanTransferService(jmri_server.service.JsonService): 
107class BeanTransferService(JsonService):
108    """Cross-profile bean transfer. Read-only ``list`` +
109    ``post`` with ``action=preview|apply``."""
110
111    topic = "beanTransfer"
112    # ``list`` is safe for any role. ``post`` writes across
113    # profiles — admin-only, since a compromised operator token
114    # shouldn't be able to leak or overwrite the production
115    # profile's beans from a staging session.
116    REQUIRED_ROLE = {
117        "list": Role.VIEWER,
118        "post": Role.ADMIN,
119    }
120
121    async def on_list(
122        self, data: dict[str, Any] | None,
123    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
124        registry = self._registry_or_none()
125        profiles_out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
126        if registry is not None:
127            active = registry.active()
128            active_id = active.id if active else None
129            for ref in registry.profiles:
130                profile = _profile_from_ref(registry, ref)
131                store = _open_store(profile)
132                profiles_out.append({
133                    "id": ref.id,
134                    "name": ref.name,
135                    "path": str(profile.profile_dir),
136                    "isActive": ref.id == active_id,
137                    "counts": {
138                        kind: _count(store, kind)
139                        for kind in SUPPORTED_TYPES
140                    },
141                })
142        return {
143            "profiles": profiles_out,
144            "types": list(SUPPORTED_TYPES),
145        }
146
147    async def on_post(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
148        data = data or {}
149        action = data.get("action")
150        if action == "preview":
151            return await self._preview(data)
152        if action == "apply":
153            return await self._apply(data)
154        raise JsonServiceError(
155            400, f"unknown beanTransfer action: {action!r}",
156        )
157
158    # ---- helpers -----------------------------------------------------
159
160    def _registry_or_none(self) -> ProfileRegistry | None:
161        registry = getattr(self.ctx, "profile_registry", None)
162        return registry if isinstance(registry, ProfileRegistry) else None
163
164    def _require_registry(self) -> ProfileRegistry:
165        registry = self._registry_or_none()
166        if registry is None:
167            raise JsonServiceError(
168                503,
169                "no profile registry loaded (no profiles.xml at settings root)",
170            )
171        return registry
172
173    def _resolve_pair(
174        self, data: dict[str, Any],
175    ) -> tuple[Profile, Profile, ProfileRef, ProfileRef, list[str]]:
176        registry = self._require_registry()
177        src_id = data.get("from")
178        dst_id = data.get("to")
179        if not isinstance(src_id, str) or not isinstance(dst_id, str):
180            raise JsonServiceError(
181                400, "beanTransfer requires 'from' and 'to' profile ids",
182            )
183        if src_id == dst_id:
184            raise JsonServiceError(
185                400, "beanTransfer 'from' and 'to' must differ",
186            )
187        src_ref = registry.by_id(src_id)
188        if src_ref is None:
189            raise JsonServiceError(
190                404, f"no source profile with id {src_id!r}",
191            )
192        dst_ref = registry.by_id(dst_id)
193        if dst_ref is None:
194            raise JsonServiceError(
195                404, f"no target profile with id {dst_id!r}",
196            )
197        raw_types = data.get("types")
198        if raw_types is None:
199            types = list(SUPPORTED_TYPES)
200        elif isinstance(raw_types, list):
201            types = [t for t in raw_types if isinstance(t, str)]
202        else:
203            raise JsonServiceError(
204                400, "'types' must be an array of bean-kind strings",
205            )
206        unknown = [t for t in types if t not in SUPPORTED_TYPES]
207        if unknown:
208            raise JsonServiceError(
209                400,
210                f"unsupported bean types: {unknown!r}. "
211                f"Supported: {list(SUPPORTED_TYPES)}",
212            )
213        if not types:
214            raise JsonServiceError(
215                400, "'types' must not be empty",
216            )
217        return (
218            _profile_from_ref(registry, src_ref),
219            _profile_from_ref(registry, dst_ref),
220            src_ref,
221            dst_ref,
222            types,
223        )
224
225    async def _preview(self, data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
226        src, dst, _sref, _dref, types = self._resolve_pair(data)
227        src_store = _open_store(src)
228        dst_store = _open_store(dst)
229        counts: dict[str, int] = {}
230        will_overwrite: dict[str, int] = {}
231        for kind in types:
232            src_names = _existing_names(src_store, kind)
233            counts[kind] = len(src_names)
234            will_overwrite[kind] = len(
235                src_names & _existing_names(dst_store, kind)
236            )
237        return {"counts": counts, "willOverwrite": will_overwrite}
238
239    async def _apply(self, data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
240        registry = self._require_registry()
241        src, dst, _sref, dst_ref, types = self._resolve_pair(data)
242        src_store = _open_store(src)
243        active = registry.active()
244        target_is_active = active is not None and dst_ref.id == active.id
245
246        # If the target is the active profile, write through the
247        # ctx.config_store the live server holds — otherwise a fresh
248        # instance we throw away, since no in-memory managers are
249        # attached to the target's beans.
250        if target_is_active and isinstance(self.ctx.config_store, ConfigStore):
251            dst_store = self.ctx.config_store
252        else:
253            dst_store = _open_store(dst)
254
255        copied: dict[str, int] = {}
256        for kind in types:
257            copied[kind] = _copy_kind(src_store, dst_store, kind)
258
259        # Re-populate live managers when we've just written into the
260        # active profile. Otherwise the caller would have to switch
261        # profile (or restart) to see the new beans in the running
262        # connection.
263        if target_is_active:
264            from jmri_server.app import _restore_beans_from_config  # noqa: PLC0415
265            await _restore_beans_from_config(
266                self.ctx.connection, dst_store,
267            )
268
269        return {"copied": copied, "targetIsActive": target_is_active}

class BlockService(jmri_server.services.beans._BeanService): 
392class BlockService(_BeanService):
393    topic = "block"
394
395    def manager(self) -> Manager[Block]:
396        return self.ctx.connection.blocks
397
398    def project(self, bean: Block) -> dict[str, Any]:
399        v = bean.value
400        return _common_named_bean(bean) | {
401            "state": to_wire(int(bean.state)),
402            "value": v if v is None or isinstance(v, str) else str(v),
403            "sensor": bean.sensor.system_name if bean.sensor is not None else None,
404            "reporter": None,
405            "speed": "",
406            "curvature": 0,
407            "direction": 0,
408            "length": 0.0,
409            "permissive": False,
410            "speedLimit": -1.0,
411            "denied": [],
412        }
413
414    async def apply(self, bean: Block, data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
415        if "value" in data:
416            await bean.set_value(data["value"])
417        if "sensor" in data:
418            sensor_name = data["sensor"]
419            sensor = (
420                self.ctx.connection.sensors.get(sensor_name) if sensor_name else None
421            )
422            bean.attach_sensor(sensor)

 80        self, data: dict[str, Any] | None,
 81    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
 82        registry = self._registry_or_none()
 83        if registry is None:
 84            return []
 85        return [_project(ref, registry) for ref in registry.profiles]
 86
 87    async def on_put(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
 88        data = data or {}
 89        name = data.get("name")
 90        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name:
 91            raise JsonServiceError(400, "configProfile.put requires 'name'")
 92        if not _SAFE_NAME_RE.match(name):
 93            raise JsonServiceError(
 94                400,
 95                "profile name must match [A-Za-z0-9._-]+ "
 96                "(filesystem-safe, no colon or path separators)",
 97            )
 98        registry = self._require_registry()
 99        # Reject duplicates by name — same-name entries would collide
100        # on disk since we store per-name subdirectories.
101        for existing in registry.profiles:
102            if existing.name == name:
103                raise JsonServiceError(
104                    409, f"profile with name {name!r} already exists",
105                )
106        # Auto-generate an id if the caller didn't specify one. JMRI's
107        # own convention is ``<name>.<8-hex>``; matching that keeps
108        # profiles.xml recognizable by a JMRI Java install if the user
109        # ever imports our settings back into it.
110        raw_id = data.get("id")
111        if isinstance(raw_id, str) and raw_id:
112            if registry.by_id(raw_id) is not None:
113                raise JsonServiceError(
114                    409, f"profile id {raw_id!r} already exists",
115                )
116            profile_id = raw_id
117        else:
118            profile_id = f"{name}.{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
119        ref = ProfileRef(
120            id=profile_id,
121            path=f"settings:{name}/",
122            name=name,
123        )
124        registry.profiles.append(ref)
125        # Persist profiles.xml before touching the filesystem so a
126        # save-failure doesn't leave orphan directories. Create the
127        # profile's dir + an empty PanelPro.xml afterwards.
128        save_profile_registry(registry)
129        profile = ref.to_profile(registry.settings_root)
130        profile.ensure()
131        _write_empty_config(profile)
132        return _project(ref, registry)
133
134    async def on_delete(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
135        data = data or {}
136        profile_id = data.get("id")
137        if not isinstance(profile_id, str) or not profile_id:
138            raise JsonServiceError(400, "configProfile.delete requires 'id'")
139        registry = self._require_registry()
140        ref = registry.by_id(profile_id)
141        if ref is None:
142            raise JsonServiceError(
143                404, f"no profile with id {profile_id!r}",
144            )
145        active = registry.active()
146        if active is not None and active.id == profile_id:
147            raise JsonServiceError(
148                409,
149                "can't delete the active profile; switch to another profile first",
150            )
151        registry.profiles = [p for p in registry.profiles if p.id != profile_id]
152        save_profile_registry(registry)
153        return {"id": profile_id, "deleted": True}
154
155    # ---- helpers ----------------------------------------------------
156
157    def _registry_or_none(self) -> ProfileRegistry | None:
158        registry = getattr(self.ctx, "profile_registry", None)
159        return registry if isinstance(registry, ProfileRegistry) else None
160
161    def _require_registry(self) -> ProfileRegistry:
162        registry = self._registry_or_none()
163        if registry is None:
164            raise JsonServiceError(
165                503,
166                "no profile registry loaded (no profiles.xml at settings root)",
167            )
168        return registry

 58class ConfigUserService(JsonService):
 59    topic = "configUser"
 60
 61    # User CRUD is admin-only for read + mutate. The self-service
 62    # POST actions do their own finer-grained checks (a viewer can
 63    # change their own password, not anyone else's) so ``post``
 64    # is gated at operator — the action handler enforces the rest.
 65    REQUIRED_ROLE = {
 66        "list": Role.ADMIN,
 67        "get": Role.ADMIN,
 68        "put": Role.ADMIN,
 69        "delete": Role.ADMIN,
 70        "post": Role.VIEWER,   # self-service always available
 71    }
 72
 73    # ---- helpers -------------------------------------------------------
 74
 75    def _auth(self):
 76        auth = getattr(self.ctx, "auth", None)
 77        if auth is None:
 78            raise JsonServiceError(
 79                503,
 80                "auth is disabled on this server (JMRI_AUTH_ENABLED not set)",
 81            )
 82        return auth
 83
 84    def _current_username(self) -> str | None:
 85        return getattr(self.ctx, "_current_username", None)
 86
 87    def _current_role(self) -> Role:
 88        """The current role is passed through dispatch to the JsonService
 89        signature, not to instances — but we can infer from the
 90        current user. When auth is off the middleware sets role=admin;
 91        we mirror that here by treating "no user" as admin."""
 92        current = self._current_username()
 93        if current is None:
 94            return Role.ADMIN
 95        user = self._auth().by_username(current)
 96        return user.role if user else Role.VIEWER

 98    # ---- CRUD ----------------------------------------------------------
 99
100    async def on_list(
101        self, data: dict[str, Any] | None,
102    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
103        auth = self._auth()
104        current = self._current_username()
105        return [
106            _project(u, self_flag=(u.username == current))
107            for u in auth.users
108        ]

110    async def on_get(
111        self, data: dict[str, Any] | None,
112    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
113        data = data or {}
114        username = data.get("username")
115        if not isinstance(username, str) or not username:
116            raise JsonServiceError(400, "configUser.get requires 'username'")
117        auth = self._auth()
118        user = auth.by_username(username)
119        if user is None:
120            raise JsonServiceError(404, f"no user {username!r}")
121        return _project(

123        )
124
125    async def on_put(
126        self, data: dict[str, Any] | None,
127    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
128        """Create or update.
129
130        For a new user: ``password`` is required, ``role`` defaults
131        to viewer. For an existing user: only the fields supplied
132        are updated (role and/or password). Changing your own role
133        would trigger the self-demotion guard — see ``set_role``.
134        """
135        data = data or {}
136        username = data.get("username")
137        password = data.get("password")
138        role_raw = data.get("role")
139        if not isinstance(username, str) or not username:
140            raise JsonServiceError(400, "configUser.put requires 'username'")
141        role: Role | None = None
142        if role_raw is not None:
143            try:
144                role = Role(role_raw)
145            except ValueError:
146                raise JsonServiceError(
147                    400,
148                    f"invalid role {role_raw!r}; must be one of "
149                    f"{[r.value for r in Role]}",
150                ) from None
151
152        auth = self._auth()
153        current = self._current_username() or ""
154        existing = auth.by_username(username)
155        if existing is None:
156            if not isinstance(password, str) or not password:
157                raise JsonServiceError(
158                    400, "creating a user requires 'password'",
159                )
160            user = auth.add_user(
161                username, password,
162                role=role if role is not None else Role.VIEWER,
163            )
164            return _project(user, self_flag=(username == current))
165
166        # Existing user — update only what's supplied.
167        if isinstance(password, str) and password:
168            auth.set_password(username, password)
169        if role is not None and role is not existing.role:
170            try:
171                auth.set_role(
172                    username, role, current_username=current,
173                )
174            except ValueError as e:
175                raise JsonServiceError(409, str(e)) from None
176        return _project(
177            auth.by_username(username),
178            self_flag=(username == current),
179        )

183    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
184        data = data or {}

188        auth = self._auth()

194        except ValueError as e:

196        return {"username": username, "deleted": True}

213    async def _change_password(
214        self, data: dict[str, Any],
215    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
216        username = data.get("username")
217        new_password = data.get("new_password")
218        if not isinstance(username, str) or not username:
219            raise JsonServiceError(400, "change_password requires 'username'")
220        if not isinstance(new_password, str) or not new_password:

222        current = self._current_username() or ""

228        auth = self._auth()

231        except LookupError as e:
232            raise JsonServiceError(404, str(e)) from None
233        return {"username": username, "changed": True}

238        username = data.get("username")
239        if not isinstance(username, str) or not username:
240            raise JsonServiceError(

242            )
243        current = self._current_username() or ""
244        if username != current and self._current_role() is not Role.ADMIN:
245            raise JsonServiceError(

248            )
249        auth = self._auth()
250        try:
251            token = auth.regenerate_token(username)
252        except LookupError as e:
253            raise JsonServiceError(404, str(e)) from None
254        return {"username": username, "token": token}

class ConsistService(jmri_server.service.JsonService): 
 98class ConsistService(JsonService):
 99    topic = "consist"
100
101    @property
102    def _consists(self) -> ConsistManager:
103        return self.ctx.connection.consists
104
105    def _require(self, address: int) -> Consist:
106        c = self._consists.get(address)
107        if c is None:
108            raise JsonServiceError(404, f"no consist at address {address}")
109        return c
110
111    async def on_list(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
112        return [_project(c, self._consists) for c in self._consists]
113
114    async def on_get(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
115        addr = _address_from(data or {})
116        return _project(self._require(addr), self._consists)
117
118    async def on_put(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
119        """Create-if-absent. Idempotent: returns the existing consist if
120        one already lives at ``address`` without overwriting its
121        members. Change comment/kind on an existing consist via a
122        follow-up ``post`` (not currently wired — the two fields are
123        immutable after create; a delete+recreate is the escape hatch).
124
125        Enforces two rules that were left implicit before:
126
127        * Consist address must be 1..127 (short only). CV19 is 7-bit,
128          so anything else is either meaningless (advanced) or
129          gratuitously inconsistent across kinds.
130        * Address must not collide with any existing roster loco. If
131          it did, the roster loco would silently participate in every
132          fan-out addressed to that consist — a footgun.
133        """
134        data = data or {}
135        addr = _address_from(data)
136        if not 1 <= addr <= CONSIST_ADDRESS_MAX:
137            raise JsonServiceError(
138                400,
139                f"consist address must be 1..{CONSIST_ADDRESS_MAX} short, "
140                f"got {addr}",
141            )
142        kind = data.get("kind")
143        comment = str(data.get("comment", ""))
144        # Validate kind against the model's Literal — raise 400 on typo.
145        if kind is not None and kind not in ("software", "command_station", "advanced"):
146            raise JsonServiceError(400, f"invalid consist kind: {kind!r}")
147        # Roster-collision check. Skip if the consist already exists
148        # at this address (idempotent create still wins).
149        if self._consists.get(addr) is None:
150            conflict = self._roster_conflict(addr)
151            if conflict is not None:
152                raise JsonServiceError(
153                    409,
154                    f"consist address {addr} collides with roster loco "
155                    f"{conflict!r} (short {addr}); pick a different "
156                    f"consist address or remove/renumber the loco.",
157                )
158        consist = await self._consists.create(addr, kind=kind, comment=comment)
159        return _project(consist, self._consists)
160
161    def _roster_conflict(self, addr: int) -> str | None:
162        """Return the id of any roster entry using *addr* as a short
163        DCC address, or ``None`` if there's no collision.
164
165        Only short addresses count — a long-address loco at the same
166        numeric value shares no wire space with a 1..127 consist. The
167        roster store is lazy-loaded here on first use (same pattern
168        as :class:`RosterService`) so the check works even when the
169        user's first action is Create-consist and no roster/throttle
170        page has been hit yet — that was a real bug where the check
171        silently short-circuited when navigation started on
172        ``/consists``.
173        """
174        store = self._roster_store()
175        if store is None:
176            return None
177        target = str(addr)
178        for entry in store:
179            if entry.long_address:
180                continue
181            if entry.dcc_address == target:
182                return entry.id
183        return None
184
185    def _roster_store(self) -> Any:
186        """Return the shared :class:`RosterStore`, constructing it on
187        first access if nothing else has touched it yet.
188
189        Uses the same context attribute (``_roster_store``) as
190        :class:`RosterService` so both see the same instance — no
191        double-load, and edits made through /roster show up in this
192        check immediately.
193        """
194        store = getattr(self.ctx, "_roster_store", None)
195        if store is not None:
196            return store
197        try:
198            from jmri_core.persistence.profile import Profile  # noqa: PLC0415
199            from jmri_server.roster_store import RosterStore  # noqa: PLC0415
200        except ImportError:
201            return None
202        profile = getattr(self.ctx, "_roster_profile", None) or Profile.default()
203        try:
204            store = RosterStore(profile=profile)
205        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
206            # No profile on disk, permission error, corrupt index — the
207            # conflict check is a courtesy, not a hard invariant. Bail
208            # rather than fail create.
209            return None
210        self.ctx._roster_store = store  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
211        return store
212
213    async def on_post(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
214        data = data or {}
215        addr = _address_from(data)
216        action = data.get("action")
217        # Every action targets an existing consist.
218        self._require(addr)
219        if action == "add_member":

222            if not isinstance(member_addr, int):
223                raise JsonServiceError(

225                )
226            await self._consists.add_member(
227                addr, member_addr,
228                long_address=bool(m.get("long_address", False)),
229                direction_normal=bool(m.get("direction_normal", True)),

232            m_addr = data.get("member_address")
233            if not isinstance(m_addr, int):
234                raise JsonServiceError(
235                    400, "consist.remove_member requires int 'member_address'",
236                )
237            if not await self._consists.remove_member(addr, m_addr):
238                raise JsonServiceError(
239                    404, f"consist {addr} has no member at {m_addr}",
240                )
241        elif action == "set_speed":
242            speed = data.get("speed")
243            if not isinstance(speed, (int, float)):
244                raise JsonServiceError(400, "consist.set_speed requires 'speed'")
245            await self._consists.set_speed(addr, float(speed))
246        elif action == "set_direction":
247            direction = data.get("direction")
248            if direction not in ("forward", "reverse"):
249                raise JsonServiceError(
250                    400, "consist.set_direction requires 'forward'|'reverse'",
251                )
252            await self._consists.set_direction(
253                addr,
254                ThrottleDirection.FORWARD if direction == "forward"

262                    400, "consist.set_function requires int 'function' + bool 'on'",
263                )
264            await self._consists.set_function(addr, fn, on)
265        elif action == "emergency_stop":
266            await self._consists.emergency_stop(addr)
267        else:
268            raise JsonServiceError(400, f"unknown consist action: {action!r}")
269        return _project(self._require(addr), self._consists)

272        data = data or {}

274        if not await self._consists.delete(addr):
275            raise JsonServiceError(404, f"no consist at address {addr}")
276        return {"address": addr, "deleted": True}

async def on_put(self, data: dict[str, typing.Any] | None) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
118    async def on_put(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
119        """Create-if-absent. Idempotent: returns the existing consist if
120        one already lives at ``address`` without overwriting its
121        members. Change comment/kind on an existing consist via a
122        follow-up ``post`` (not currently wired — the two fields are
123        immutable after create; a delete+recreate is the escape hatch).
124
125        Enforces two rules that were left implicit before:
126
127        * Consist address must be 1..127 (short only). CV19 is 7-bit,
128          so anything else is either meaningless (advanced) or
129          gratuitously inconsistent across kinds.
130        * Address must not collide with any existing roster loco. If
131          it did, the roster loco would silently participate in every
132          fan-out addressed to that consist — a footgun.
133        """
134        data = data or {}
135        addr = _address_from(data)
136        if not 1 <= addr <= CONSIST_ADDRESS_MAX:
137            raise JsonServiceError(
138                400,
139                f"consist address must be 1..{CONSIST_ADDRESS_MAX} short, "
140                f"got {addr}",
141            )
142        kind = data.get("kind")
143        comment = str(data.get("comment", ""))
144        # Validate kind against the model's Literal — raise 400 on typo.
145        if kind is not None and kind not in ("software", "command_station", "advanced"):
146            raise JsonServiceError(400, f"invalid consist kind: {kind!r}")
147        # Roster-collision check. Skip if the consist already exists
148        # at this address (idempotent create still wins).
149        if self._consists.get(addr) is None:
150            conflict = self._roster_conflict(addr)
151            if conflict is not None:
152                raise JsonServiceError(
153                    409,
154                    f"consist address {addr} collides with roster loco "
155                    f"{conflict!r} (short {addr}); pick a different "
156                    f"consist address or remove/renumber the loco.",
157                )
158        consist = await self._consists.create(addr, kind=kind, comment=comment)
159        return _project(consist, self._consists)

26class IdTagService(_BeanService):
27    topic = "idTag"
28
29    def manager(self) -> IdTagManager:
30        return self.ctx.connection.id_tags
31
32    def project(self, bean: IdTag) -> dict[str, Any]:
33        return _common_named_bean(bean) | {
34            "state": bean.state,
35            "reporter": bean.reporter_name,
36            "time": bean.time,
37        }
38
39    async def apply(self, bean: IdTag, data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
40        # Scripts + tests can set state + reporter + time directly. The
41        # reporter reference is opaque (a bean name string); the JSON
42        # layer doesn't cross-check against the reporter manager
43        # because a report can name a reporter on a different profile.
44        if "state" in data:
45            state = int(data["state"])
46            if state not in (
47                ID_TAG_STATE_UNKNOWN,
48                ID_TAG_STATE_SEEN,
49                ID_TAG_STATE_UNSEEN,
50            ):
51                raise JsonServiceError(
52                    400, f"invalid idTag state: {state}",
53                )
54            when = str(data.get("time") or "")
55            reporter = data.get("reporter")
56            if state == ID_TAG_STATE_SEEN:
57                if not isinstance(reporter, str) or not reporter:
58                    raise JsonServiceError(
59                        400,
60                        "idTag.state=SEEN requires a 'reporter' name",
61                    )
62                await bean.report_seen(reporter, when)
63            elif state == ID_TAG_STATE_UNSEEN:
64                await bean.report_unseen(when)
65            else:
66                # UNKNOWN: reset everything.
67                bean._state = state  # noqa: SLF001 — internal reset
68                bean._reporter_name = None  # noqa: SLF001
69                bean._time = None  # noqa: SLF001
70                await bean.state_changed.emit(state)

17class LayoutBlockService(_BeanService):
18    topic = "layoutBlock"
19
20    def manager(self) -> LayoutBlockManager:
21        return self.ctx.connection.layout_blocks
22
23    def project(self, bean: LayoutBlock) -> dict[str, Any]:
24        return _common_named_bean(bean) | {
25            "state": bean.state,
26            "block": bean.block,
27            "memory": bean.memory,
28            "occupancySensor": bean.occupancy_sensor,
29            "occupiedSense": bean.occupied_sense,
30            "blockColor": bean.block_color,
31            "trackColor": bean.track_color,
32            "occupiedColor": bean.occupied_color,
33            "extraColor": bean.extra_color,
34            "useExtraColor": bean.use_extra_color,
35        }
36
37    async def apply(self, bean: LayoutBlock, data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
38        # Every field is a straight assignment — no signal fires here
39        # because Panel Editor isn't wired yet. When it lands, this
40        # method grows a "notify state_changed" branch for occupancy
41        # transitions.
42        for wire_field, attr in (
43            ("block", "block"),
44            ("memory", "memory"),
45            ("occupancySensor", "occupancy_sensor"),
46            ("blockColor", "block_color"),
47            ("trackColor", "track_color"),
48            ("occupiedColor", "occupied_color"),
49            ("extraColor", "extra_color"),
50        ):
51            if wire_field in data:
52                val = data[wire_field]
53                setattr(bean, attr, str(val) if val is not None else None)
54        if "occupiedSense" in data:
55            bean.occupied_sense = int(data["occupiedSense"])
56        if "useExtraColor" in data:
57            bean.use_extra_color = bool(data["useExtraColor"])
58        if "state" in data:
59            bean.state = int(data["state"])

class LogixNGService(jmri_server.service.JsonService): 
 78class LogixNGService(JsonService):
 79    topic = "logixng"
 80
 81    async def on_list(
 82        self, data: dict[str, Any] | None,
 83    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
 84        mgr = _require_manager(self.ctx)
 85        return [
 86            _project(name, mgr.get(name))       # type: ignore[arg-type]
 87            for name in mgr.names()
 88        ]
 89
 90    async def on_get(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
 91        mgr = _require_manager(self.ctx)
 92        name = self._require_name(data or {})
 93        prog = mgr.get(name)
 94        if prog is None:
 95            raise JsonServiceError(404, f"no logixng named {name!r}")
 96        return _project(name, prog)
 97
 98    async def on_put(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
 99        """Create-or-replace by name. Body may be:
100
101        * an empty program: only ``name`` + optional ``userName``.
102        * a full tree: ``tree`` field carrying the nested dict the
103          YAML serializer produced.
104        """
105        mgr = _require_manager(self.ctx)
106        data = data or {}
107        name = self._require_name(data)
108        tree = data.get("tree")
109        if tree is None:
110            prog = await mgr.create(
111                name,
112                user_name=str(data.get("userName") or ""),
113                enabled=bool(data.get("enabled", True)),
114            )
115        else:
116            if not isinstance(tree, dict):
117                raise JsonServiceError(
118                    400, "logixng.put tree must be a mapping",
119                )
120            try:
121                node = from_dict(tree)
122            except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as e:
123                raise JsonServiceError(
124                    400, f"logixng tree decode failed: {e}",
125                ) from None
126            if not isinstance(node, LogixNG):
127                raise JsonServiceError(
128                    400, "logixng tree must have type=logixng:root",
129                )
130            prog = await mgr.put(name, node)
131        self._persist(mgr, name)
132        return _project(name, prog)
133
134    async def on_delete(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
135        mgr = _require_manager(self.ctx)
136        name = self._require_name(data or {})
137        if not await mgr.delete(name):
138            raise JsonServiceError(404, f"no logixng named {name!r}")
139        self._persist_delete(name)
140        return {"name": name, "deleted": True}
141
142    async def on_post(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
143        mgr = _require_manager(self.ctx)
144        data = data or {}
145        name = self._require_name(data)
146        prog = mgr.get(name)
147        if prog is None:
148            raise JsonServiceError(404, f"no logixng named {name!r}")
149        command = data.get("command")
150        if command == "enable":
151            prog.enabled = True
152            await mgr.updated.emit(prog)
153            self._persist(mgr, name)
154        elif command == "disable":
155            prog.enabled = False
156            await mgr.updated.emit(prog)
157            self._persist(mgr, name)
158        elif command == "run":
159            await self._run(prog)
160        elif command == "run_conditional":
161            target_id = data.get("conditional_id")
162            if not isinstance(target_id, str):
163                raise JsonServiceError(
164                    400,
165                    "logixng.run_conditional requires 'conditional_id'",
166                )
167            await self._run_one(prog, target_id)
168        else:
169            raise JsonServiceError(400, f"unknown logixng command: {command!r}")
170        return _project(name, prog)
171
172    # ---- helpers -------------------------------------------------------
173
174    async def _run(self, prog: LogixNG) -> None:
175        exec_ctx = ExecutionContext(connection=self.ctx.connection)
176        try:
177            await prog.execute_all(exec_ctx)
178        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
179            _log.exception("LogixNG %s run failed", prog.user_name or "?")
180            raise JsonServiceError(500, f"logixng run failed: {e}") from None
181
182    async def _run_one(self, prog: LogixNG, conditional_id: str) -> None:
183        target = next(
184            (c for c in prog.conditionals if c.id == conditional_id),
185            None,
186        )
187        if target is None:
188            raise JsonServiceError(
189                404, f"no conditional {conditional_id!r} in this logixng",
190            )
191        exec_ctx = ExecutionContext(connection=self.ctx.connection)
192        try:
193            await target.execute(exec_ctx)
194        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
195            _log.exception("LogixNG conditional %s run failed", conditional_id)
196            raise JsonServiceError(
197                500, f"conditional run failed: {e}",
198            ) from None
199
200    def _require_name(self, data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
201        name = data.get("name")
202        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name:
203            raise JsonServiceError(400, "logixng request requires 'name'")
204        return name
205
206    def _persist(self, mgr: LogixNGManager, name: str) -> None:
207        root = getattr(self.ctx, "_logixng_dir", None)
208        if root is None:
209            return
210        mgr.save_one(root, name)
211
212    def _persist_delete(self, name: str) -> None:
213        root = getattr(self.ctx, "_logixng_dir", None)
214        mgr = _require_manager(self.ctx)
215        if root is not None:
216            mgr.delete_on_disk(root, name)

async def on_get(self, data: dict[str, typing.Any] | None) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
90    async def on_get(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
91        mgr = _require_manager(self.ctx)
92        name = self._require_name(data or {})
93        prog = mgr.get(name)
94        if prog is None:
95            raise JsonServiceError(404, f"no logixng named {name!r}")
96        return _project(name, prog)
async def on_put(self, data: dict[str, typing.Any] | None) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
 98    async def on_put(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
 99        """Create-or-replace by name. Body may be:
100
101        * an empty program: only ``name`` + optional ``userName``.
102        * a full tree: ``tree`` field carrying the nested dict the
103          YAML serializer produced.
104        """
105        mgr = _require_manager(self.ctx)
106        data = data or {}
107        name = self._require_name(data)
108        tree = data.get("tree")
109        if tree is None:
110            prog = await mgr.create(
111                name,
112                user_name=str(data.get("userName") or ""),
113                enabled=bool(data.get("enabled", True)),
114            )
115        else:
116            if not isinstance(tree, dict):
117                raise JsonServiceError(
118                    400, "logixng.put tree must be a mapping",
119                )
120            try:
121                node = from_dict(tree)
122            except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as e:
123                raise JsonServiceError(
124                    400, f"logixng tree decode failed: {e}",
125                ) from None
126            if not isinstance(node, LogixNG):
127                raise JsonServiceError(
128                    400, "logixng tree must have type=logixng:root",
129                )
130            prog = await mgr.put(name, node)
131        self._persist(mgr, name)
132        return _project(name, prog)

Create-or-replace by name. Body may be:

  • an empty program: only name + optional userName.
  • a full tree: tree field carrying the nested dict the YAML serializer produced.
async def on_delete(self, data: dict[str, typing.Any] | None) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
134    async def on_delete(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
135        mgr = _require_manager(self.ctx)
136        name = self._require_name(data or {})
137        if not await mgr.delete(name):
138            raise JsonServiceError(404, f"no logixng named {name!r}")
139        self._persist_delete(name)
140        return {"name": name, "deleted": True}
async def on_post(self, data: dict[str, typing.Any] | None) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
142    async def on_post(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
143        mgr = _require_manager(self.ctx)
144        data = data or {}
145        name = self._require_name(data)
146        prog = mgr.get(name)
147        if prog is None:
148            raise JsonServiceError(404, f"no logixng named {name!r}")
149        command = data.get("command")
150        if command == "enable":
151            prog.enabled = True
152            await mgr.updated.emit(prog)
153            self._persist(mgr, name)
154        elif command == "disable":
155            prog.enabled = False
156            await mgr.updated.emit(prog)
157            self._persist(mgr, name)
158        elif command == "run":
159            await self._run(prog)
160        elif command == "run_conditional":
161            target_id = data.get("conditional_id")
162            if not isinstance(target_id, str):
163                raise JsonServiceError(
164                    400,
165                    "logixng.run_conditional requires 'conditional_id'",
166                )
167            await self._run_one(prog, target_id)
168        else:
169            raise JsonServiceError(400, f"unknown logixng command: {command!r}")
170        return _project(name, prog)

108class PanelService(JsonService):
109    """List panels on disk under the active profile.
110
111    Supports ``list`` and ``get`` (by ``name``). No ``put`` / ``post``
112    / ``delete`` — panel authoring goes through Panel Editor, not this
113    service.
114    """
115
116    topic = "panel"
117
118    async def on_list(
119        self, data: dict[str, Any] | None,
120    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
121        return list(self._all_panels())
122
123    async def on_get(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
124        data = data or {}
125        name = data.get("name")
126        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name:
127            raise JsonServiceError(400, "panel.get requires 'name'")
128        for panel in self._all_panels():
129            if panel["name"] == name:
130                return panel
131        raise JsonServiceError(404, f"no panel named {name!r}")
132
133    def _all_panels(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
134        panels_dir = _panels_dir(self.ctx)
135        if panels_dir is None:
136            return []
137        out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
138        for xml_path in sorted(panels_dir.glob("*.xml")):
139            projection = _project(xml_path)
140            if projection is not None:
141                out.append(projection)
142        return out

158class ProgrammerService(JsonService):
159    topic = "programmer"
160
161    async def on_get(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
162        data = data or {}
163        cv = data.get("cv")
164        if not isinstance(cv, int):
165            raise JsonServiceError(400, "programmer.get requires integer 'cv'")
166        programmer = _resolve_programmer(self.ctx.connection, data)
167        try:

169        except TimeoutError:
170            raise JsonServiceError(504, f"timeout reading CV {cv}") from None
171        except NotImplementedError as e:

173            raise JsonServiceError(501, str(e)) from None
174        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
175            # Connection-specific errors (NceCommandError, LocoNet CS
176            # NACKs, DCC-EX parse failures). Surface as 502 so the UI
177            # can distinguish from timeouts/protocol errors upstream.
178            raise JsonServiceError(502, f"CV {cv} read failed: {e}") from None
179        # Record the freshly-read value in the in-memory cache so the
180        # next pane render (and subsequent variable_extract_from_state
181        # calls) sees it. JMRI Java treats reads as transient — no
182        # disk persistence, no ``.bak`` — until the user explicitly
183        # saves. We mirror that via ``record_read_result`` rather than
184        # ``set_cv``. A Read pane over 28 CVs used to translate into
185        # 28 atomic disk writes (rough on SD cards); now it's zero.
186        loco_id = data.get("locoId") or data.get("loco_id")
187        if isinstance(loco_id, str) and loco_id:
188            file_name = data.get("fileName") or data.get("file_name")
189            if not isinstance(file_name, str):
190                file_name = None
191            _loco_cv_store(self.ctx).record_read_result(
192                loco_id, str(cv), value, file_name,
193            )
194        return {"cv": cv, "value": value, "mode": programmer.mode.value}
195
196    async def on_post(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
197        data = data or {}
198        cv = data.get("cv")
199        value = data.get("value")
200        if not isinstance(cv, int):
201            raise JsonServiceError(400, "programmer.post requires integer 'cv'")
202        if not isinstance(value, int) or not CV_VALUE_MIN <= value <= CV_VALUE_MAX:
203            raise JsonServiceError(
204                400,
205                f"programmer.post requires integer 'value' {CV_VALUE_MIN}..{CV_VALUE_MAX}",
206            )
207        programmer = _resolve_programmer(self.ctx.connection, data)
208        try:
209            await programmer.write_cv(cv, value)
210        except TimeoutError:
211            raise JsonServiceError(504, f"timeout writing CV {cv}") from None
212        except NotImplementedError as e:
213            raise JsonServiceError(501, str(e)) from None
214        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
215            raise JsonServiceError(502, f"CV {cv} write failed: {e}") from None
216        # Persist the committed write to the per-loco CV file if a loco
217        # was identified — keeps the on-disk state in sync with what
218        # was actually programmed. JMRI's roster ``fileName`` attribute
219        # decouples loco-id from filename (e.g. id=459 fileName=1.xml).
220        loco_id = data.get("locoId") or data.get("loco_id")
221        if isinstance(loco_id, str) and loco_id:
222            file_name = data.get("fileName") or data.get("file_name")
223            if not isinstance(file_name, str):
224                file_name = None
225            _loco_cv_store(self.ctx).set_cv(loco_id, str(cv), value, file_name)
226        return {"cv": cv, "value": value, "mode": programmer.mode.value}
227
228    async def on_list(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
229        """Report what programmers are available on the active connection."""
230        out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
231        global_prog = self.ctx.connection.programmers.global_programmer()
232        out.append({
233            "mode": ProgrammingMode.SERVICE_DIRECT.value,
234            "available": global_prog is not None,
235        })
236        # Ops-mode availability per-address; we report just the manager-level capability.
237        try:
238            ops_capable = (
239                self.ctx.connection.programmers.ops_programmer(3) is not None
240            )
241        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
242            ops_capable = False
243        out.append({
244            "mode": ProgrammingMode.OPS_MODE.value,
245            "available": ops_capable,
246        })
247        return out

362class ReporterService(_BeanService):
363    topic = "reporter"
364
365    def manager(self) -> Manager[Reporter]:
366        return self.ctx.connection.reporters

368    def project(self, bean: Reporter) -> dict[str, Any]:
369        report = bean.current_report
370        last = bean.last_report
371        # ``value`` defaults to a sentinel string per JMRI convention.
372        value = (
373            str(report) if report not in (None, "") else "<no report>"
374        )
375        # state mirrors active/inactive based on whether we have a report.
376        state = 2 if report not in (None, "") else 4  # ACTIVE / INACTIVE wire
377        return _common_named_bean(bean) | {
378            "state": state,
379            "report": None if report is None else str(report),
380            "lastReport": None if last is None else str(last),
381            "value": value,
382        }
383
384    async def apply(self, bean: Reporter, data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
385        if "report" in data:
386            await bean.set_report(data["report"])

139    def _store(self) -> Any:
140        """Return the active RosterStore. Lazily constructed on first
141        use via :func:`_lazy_roster_store`. Raises if no profile can
142        be resolved — the service can't function without one, unlike
143        the roster-media routes which just 404."""
144        store = _lazy_roster_store(self.ctx)
145        if store is None:
146            raise RuntimeError("no roster store on the context")

149    async def on_list(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
150        profile = self._store.profile

158        entry = self._store.get(entry_id)

160            raise JsonServiceError(404, f"no roster entry with id {entry_id!r}")
161        return _entry_to_json(entry, profile=self._store.profile)
162

164        data = data or {}
165        entry_id = data.get("id")
166        if not isinstance(entry_id, str) or not entry_id:
167            raise JsonServiceError(400, "roster.put requires a non-empty 'id'")
168        existing = self._store.get(entry_id)
169        entry = _json_to_entry(data, base=existing)
170        return _entry_to_json(self._store.put(entry), profile=self._store.profile)

180        entry = _json_to_entry(data, base=existing)
181        return _entry_to_json(self._store.put(entry), profile=self._store.profile)

185        entry_id = data.get("id")

class ScriptsService(jmri_server.service.JsonService): 
 79class ScriptsService(JsonService):
 80    topic = "scripts"
 81    # Scripts execute arbitrary Python on the server — that's
 82    # remote-code-execution surface. Restrict mutations to admin
 83    # so a compromised operator token can't drop a script that
 84    # steals the settings dir or reads users.yaml. Reads (list /
 85    # get) are fine for operators — they may want to inspect
 86    # what's running.
 87    REQUIRED_ROLE = {
 88        "list": Role.OPERATOR,
 89        "get": Role.OPERATOR,
 90        "put": Role.ADMIN,
 91        "post": Role.ADMIN,
 92    }
 93
 94    @property
 95    def _runner(self) -> ScriptRunner:
 96        # Cache the runner on the context. Lazy because the event loop
 97        # isn't running at app-construction time.
 98        cached = getattr(self.ctx, "_script_runner", None)
 99        if cached is None:
100            loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
101            cached = ScriptRunner.for_connection(loop, self.ctx.connection)
102            self.ctx._script_runner = cached  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
103        return cached
104
105    def _python_dirs(self) -> list[tuple[pathlib.Path, str]]:
106        """The two autoload/library dirs, in scan order, tagged by
107        source (``"shared"`` for the settings-root dir, ``"profile"``
108        for the active profile's dir). Missing profile → empty list."""
109        profile = getattr(self.ctx, "_roster_profile", None)
110        if not isinstance(profile, Profile):
111            return []
112        return [
113            (profile.shared_python_dir, "shared"),
114            (profile.python_dir, "profile"),
115        ]
116
117    def _profile_python_dir(self) -> pathlib.Path | None:
118        """Save target for user-submitted scripts. Shared scripts are
119        operator-managed; the UI writes to the per-profile dir only."""
120        profile = getattr(self.ctx, "_roster_profile", None)
121        return profile.python_dir if isinstance(profile, Profile) else None
122
123    def _find_script_on_disk(self, name: str) -> pathlib.Path | None:
124        """Locate ``<name>.py`` under the per-profile or shared dir.
125
126        Per-profile wins when both exist — matches the autoload
127        order that shipped in the python-dir migration. Returns
128        None when neither dir has the file; the caller surfaces
129        that as 404 so the UI can distinguish "script not on
130        disk" from "run failed"."""
131        for dir_path, _tag in self._python_dirs():
132            candidate = dir_path / f"{name}.py"
133            if candidate.is_file():
134                return candidate
135        return None
136
137    async def on_list(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> Any:
138        data = data or {}
139        if data.get("library"):
140            # Library shape: everything the runner *knows about* (either
141            # running or persisted on disk) so the UI can render a
142            # single table. Scripts are keyed by name — a per-profile
143            # file with the same name as a shared one wins (last write
144            # in scan order), matching the runner's autoload behaviour.
145            statuses = {s.name: _status_to_dict(s) for s in self._runner.list()}
146            for dir_path, source_tag in self._python_dirs():
147                if not dir_path.is_dir():
148                    continue
149                for p in sorted(dir_path.glob("*.py")):
150                    if p.name.startswith("_"):
151                        continue
152                    entry = statuses.setdefault(p.stem, {
153                        "name": p.stem, "started_at": None,
154                        "finished": False, "error": None, "running": False,
155                        "stdout": "", "stderr": "",
156                    })
157                    entry["path"] = str(p)
158                    entry["source"] = source_tag
159            return list(statuses.values())
160        return [_status_to_dict(s) for s in self._runner.list()]
161
162    async def on_get(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
163        data = data or {}
164        name = data.get("name")
165        if not isinstance(name, str):
166            raise JsonServiceError(400, "scripts.get requires 'name'")
167        status = self._runner.get(name)
168        if status is None:
169            raise JsonServiceError(404, f"no script named {name!r}")
170        return _status_to_dict(status)
171
172    async def on_put(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
173        data = data or {}
174        name = data.get("name")
175        source = data.get("source")
176        save = bool(data.get("save", False))
177        if not isinstance(name, str) or not isinstance(source, str):
178            raise JsonServiceError(400, "scripts.put requires 'name' and 'source'")
179        if save:
180            # Persist to <profile>/python/<name>.py so the script
181            # autoloads on next boot. Requires an active profile.
182            # Shared scripts under <settings>/python/ are not writable
183            # via the API — operator drops them by hand.
184            _sanitize_library_name(name)
185            pdir = self._profile_python_dir()
186            if pdir is None:
187                raise JsonServiceError(
188                    409,
189                    "cannot save: no active profile has a python dir",
190                )
191            pdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
192            path = pdir / f"{name}.py"
193            path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
194            status = self._runner.run_file(path, name=name)
195        else:
196            status = self._runner.run_source(source, name=name)
197        return _status_to_dict(status)
198
199    async def on_post(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
200        data = data or {}
201        name = data.get("name")
202        action = data.get("action", "stop")
203        if not isinstance(name, str):
204            raise JsonServiceError(400, "scripts.post requires 'name'")
205        if action == "delete":
206            _sanitize_library_name(name)
207            # Stop any running instance, then remove the on-disk file.
208            # Only per-profile scripts are removable via the API —
209            # shared scripts under <settings>/python/ are operator
210            # artefacts. A shared file with the same name blocks the
211            # delete with 409 so the caller sees why.
212            pdir = self._profile_python_dir()
213            profile_path = (pdir / f"{name}.py") if pdir else None
214            shared_dir = None
215            profile = getattr(self.ctx, "_roster_profile", None)
216            if isinstance(profile, Profile):
217                shared_dir = profile.shared_python_dir
218            shared_path = (
219                shared_dir / f"{name}.py" if shared_dir else None
220            )
221            if (
222                (profile_path is None or not profile_path.is_file())
223                and shared_path is not None
224                and shared_path.is_file()
225            ):
226                raise JsonServiceError(
227                    409,
228                    f"script {name!r} lives under the shared python dir; "
229                    f"remove it from disk manually",
230                )
231            self._runner.stop(name)
232            if profile_path is not None and profile_path.is_file():
233                profile_path.unlink()
234            status = self._runner.get(name)
235            return _status_to_dict(status) if status else {"name": name, "deleted": True}
236        if action == "run_file":
237            # Re-read the on-disk file (per-profile first, then
238            # shared) and hand it to the runner. This is the "debug
239            # loop" primitive — edit the file externally, click
240            # Run in the UI, see fresh output. The runner replaces
241            # any existing status entry with the same name so
242            # re-runs stack cleanly (previous automatons get
243            # stopped first).
244            _sanitize_library_name(name)
245            path = self._find_script_on_disk(name)
246            if path is None:
247                raise JsonServiceError(
248                    404,
249                    f"no script named {name!r} on disk under the "
250                    "profile or shared python dirs",
251                )
252            status = self._runner.run_file(path, name=name)
253            return _status_to_dict(status)
254        if action != "stop":
255            raise JsonServiceError(400, f"unknown scripts action: {action!r}")
256        if not self._runner.stop(name):
257            raise JsonServiceError(404, f"no script named {name!r}")
258        status = self._runner.get(name)
259        return _status_to_dict(status) if status else {"name": name}

Base class for a topic's service handlers.

Subclasses set topic and override the methods they support; unsupported methods raise 405 by default. Subclasses can also override REQUIRED_ROLE to change per-method role gates.

topic = 'scripts'
REQUIRED_ROLE = {'list': <Role.OPERATOR: 'operator'>, 'get': <Role.OPERATOR: 'operator'>, 'put': <Role.ADMIN: 'admin'>, 'post': <Role.ADMIN: 'admin'>}
async def on_list(self, data: dict[str, typing.Any] | None) -> Any: 
137    async def on_list(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> Any:
138        data = data or {}
139        if data.get("library"):
140            # Library shape: everything the runner *knows about* (either
141            # running or persisted on disk) so the UI can render a
142            # single table. Scripts are keyed by name — a per-profile
143            # file with the same name as a shared one wins (last write
144            # in scan order), matching the runner's autoload behaviour.
145            statuses = {s.name: _status_to_dict(s) for s in self._runner.list()}
146            for dir_path, source_tag in self._python_dirs():
147                if not dir_path.is_dir():
148                    continue
149                for p in sorted(dir_path.glob("*.py")):
150                    if p.name.startswith("_"):
151                        continue
152                    entry = statuses.setdefault(p.stem, {
153                        "name": p.stem, "started_at": None,
154                        "finished": False, "error": None, "running": False,
155                        "stdout": "", "stderr": "",
156                    })
157                    entry["path"] = str(p)
158                    entry["source"] = source_tag
159            return list(statuses.values())
160        return [_status_to_dict(s) for s in self._runner.list()]

167        status = self._runner.get(name)

170        return _status_to_dict(status)

194            status = self._runner.run_file(path, name=name)
195        else:

197        return _status_to_dict(status)

180class SensorService(_BeanService):
181    topic = "sensor"
182
183    def manager(self) -> Manager[Sensor]:
184        return self.ctx.connection.sensors
185
186    def project(self, bean: Sensor) -> dict[str, Any]:
187        return _common_named_bean(bean) | {
188            "inverted": bean.inverted,
189            "state": to_wire(int(bean.known_state)),
190        }
191
192    async def apply(self, bean: Sensor, data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
193        if "inverted" in data:
194            bean.inverted = bool(data["inverted"])
195        if "state" in data:
196            await bean._set_known_state(sensor_from_wire(int(data["state"])))
197
198    def _persist(self, bean: AbstractNamedBean) -> None:
199        store = getattr(self.ctx, "config_store", None)
200        if store is None:
201            return
202        assert isinstance(bean, Sensor)
203        from jmri_core.persistence import SensorRow  # noqa: PLC0415
204        store.upsert_sensor(SensorRow(
205            system_name=bean.system_name,
206            user_name=bean.user_name or None,
207            inverted=bool(bean.inverted),
208        ))
209
210    def _persist_delete(self, system_name: str) -> None:
211        store = getattr(self.ctx, "config_store", None)
212        if store is not None:
213            store.remove_sensor(system_name)

class SignalMastService(jmri_server.services.beans._BeanService): 
294class SignalMastService(_BeanService):
295    topic = "signalMast"
296
297    def manager(self) -> Manager[SignalMast]:
298        return self.ctx.connection.signal_masts
299
300    def project(self, bean: SignalMast) -> dict[str, Any]:
301        # state per schema: "dark" if not lit, "held" if held, else the aspect name.
302        if bean.held:
303            state = "Held"
304        elif not bean.aspect:
305            state = "Dark"
306        else:
307            state = bean.aspect
308        projection = _common_named_bean(bean) | {
309            "aspect": bean.aspect,
310            "lit": bool(bean.aspect) and not bean.held,
311            "held": bean.held,
312            "state": state,
313            "signalSystem": bean.signal_system or None,
314        }
315        # Best-effort valid-aspect list from the signal-system loader.
316        # Adds ``validAspects: [str, ...]`` when the mast carries a
317        # ``signal_system`` that the loader knows about; skipped when
318        # the loader hasn't been touched yet (avoids constructing it
319        # for every bean-list request when no XML root is configured).
320        loader = getattr(self.ctx, "_signal_system_loader", None)
321        if loader is not None and bean.signal_system:
322            system = loader.get(bean.signal_system)
323            if system is not None:
324                projection["validAspects"] = [
325                    a.name for a in system.aspects
326                ]
327        return projection
328
329    async def apply(self, bean: SignalMast, data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
330        if "signalSystem" in data:
331            v = data["signalSystem"]
332            bean.signal_system = str(v) if v is not None else ""
333        if "aspect" in data:
334            await bean.set_aspect(str(data["aspect"]))
335        if "held" in data:
336            await bean.set_held(bool(data["held"]))

119class TimeService(JsonService):
120    """Fast Clock JSON service. Topic: ``time``."""
121
122    topic = "time"
123
124    async def on_get(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
125        conn = _hardware_clock(self.ctx)
126        clock = _get_or_create_clock(self.ctx)
127        if conn is not None:
128            # When the CS cache is fresh, return the software bean —
129            # which was mirrored from the last CS read and continues to
130            # advance locally. This bounds CS-side traffic to one poll
131            # per ``HARDWARE_CLOCK_CACHE_S`` so co-tenant readers (turnout
132            # monitor, AIU poller) keep their airtime.
133            if _cache_is_fresh(self.ctx):
134                return _project(clock)
135            try:
136                state = await conn.read_hardware_clock()
137            except (TimeoutError, OSError) as e:
138                _log.warning("hardware clock read failed, using bean: %s", e)
139            else:
140                _mirror_to_bean(clock, state)
141                _record_cache(self.ctx)
142                return _project_hardware(state)
143        return _project(clock)
144
145    async def on_post(self, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
146        data = data or {}
147        clock = _get_or_create_clock(self.ctx)
148        conn = _hardware_clock(self.ctx)
149
150        # Apply each field if present. On hardware-backed connections,
151        # write through to the CS *first* — the software bean cache is
152        # then refreshed from a follow-up read. Hardware writes can time
153        # out under serial-link contention; surface those as a 504-ish
154        # JsonServiceError instead of a bare 500 so the UI can show a
155        # graceful message.
156        if "rate" in data:
157            try:
158                rate = float(data["rate"])
159            except (TypeError, ValueError):
160                raise JsonServiceError(400, "rate must be numeric") from None
161            if conn is not None:
162                try:
163                    await conn.set_hardware_clock_rate(rate)
164                except TimeoutError:
165                    raise JsonServiceError(
166                        504, "command station did not acknowledge the rate change"
167                    ) from None
168            try:
169                await clock.set_rate(rate)
170            except ValueError as e:
171                raise JsonServiceError(400, str(e)) from None
172
173        if "time" in data:
174            value = data["time"]
175            if not isinstance(value, str):
176                raise JsonServiceError(400, "time must be 'HH:MM' string")
177            hours, minutes = _parse_hhmm(value)
178            if conn is not None:
179                try:
180                    await conn.set_hardware_clock_time(hours, minutes, 0)
181                except TimeoutError:
182                    raise JsonServiceError(
183                        504, "command station did not acknowledge the time change"
184                    ) from None
185            try:
186                await clock.set_time(hours, minutes)
187            except ValueError as e:
188                raise JsonServiceError(400, str(e)) from None
189
190        if "running" in data:
191            run = bool(data["running"])
192            if conn is not None:
193                try:
194                    if run:
195                        await conn.start_hardware_clock()
196                    else:
197                        await conn.stop_hardware_clock()
198                except TimeoutError:
199                    raise JsonServiceError(
200                        504, "command station did not acknowledge start/stop"
201                    ) from None
202            if run:
203                await clock.start()
204            else:
205                await clock.stop()
206
207        # Re-project from the CS if we have one so the caller sees the
208        # authoritative state, not the (possibly stale) bean. A write
209        # always invalidates the cache — the caller needs the ground
210        # truth to know its update took effect.
211        if conn is not None:
212            _invalidate_cache(self.ctx)
213            try:
214                state = await conn.read_hardware_clock()
215            except (TimeoutError, OSError) as e:
216                _log.warning("hardware clock read after write failed: %s", e)
217            else:
218                _mirror_to_bean(clock, state)
219                _record_cache(self.ctx)
220                return _project_hardware(state)
221        return _project(clock)

class TurnoutService(jmri_server.services.beans._BeanService): 
136class TurnoutService(_BeanService):
137    topic = "turnout"
138
139    def manager(self) -> Manager[Turnout]:
140        return self.ctx.connection.turnouts
141
142    def project(self, bean: Turnout) -> dict[str, Any]:
143        return _common_named_bean(bean) | {
144            "inverted": bean.inverted,
145            "state": to_wire(int(bean.known_state)),
146            "feedbackMode": int(bean.feedback_mode),
147            "feedbackModes": [int(f) for f in TurnoutFeedback],
148        }
149
150    async def apply(self, bean: Turnout, data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
151        if "inverted" in data:
152            bean.inverted = bool(data["inverted"])
153        if "feedbackMode" in data:
154            bean.feedback_mode = TurnoutFeedback(int(data["feedbackMode"]))
155        if "state" in data:
156            await bean.set_commanded_state(turnout_from_wire(int(data["state"])))
157
158    def _persist(self, bean: AbstractNamedBean) -> None:
159        store = getattr(self.ctx, "config_store", None)
160        if store is None:
161            return
162        assert isinstance(bean, Turnout)
163        from jmri_core.persistence import TurnoutRow  # noqa: PLC0415
164        store.upsert_turnout(TurnoutRow(
165            system_name=bean.system_name,
166            user_name=bean.user_name or None,
167            feedback=bean.feedback_mode.name if bean.feedback_mode else None,
168            inverted=bool(bean.inverted),
169        ))
170
171    def _persist_delete(self, system_name: str) -> None:
172        store = getattr(self.ctx, "config_store", None)
173        if store is not None:
174            store.remove_turnout(system_name)
